video_title: N3on Meets Michael Porter Jr. (NBA Star)

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on the Nuggets missing the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: It's the longest offseason I've had. We didn't make the playoffs, so really I just get to chill.
quotes.quote: It's the longest offseason I've had. We didn't make the playoffs, so really I just get to chill, do what I want. So, I'm enjoying it. I haven't picked up a ball in probably a month. That's the longest I've ever not touched a basketball since I played basketball.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr.'s top five three-point shooters in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to say Steph, I'm going to say Dame, Lillard. He hasn't played, but I'm going to say Dame still.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say Steph, I'm going to say Dame, Lillard. He hasn't played, but I'm going to say Dame still. And other than that, I mean, what, what can Klay Thompson shoot? He shot like 45% I think.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on who he is rooting for in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I think I want to say the Spurs, only because I don't want OKC to go back-to-back.
quotes.quote: I think I want to say the Spurs, only because I don't want OKC to go back-to-back. But also, I think you know what would be cool? If the Sixers beat Boston and then the Sixers come out the East. I mean, Joel Embiid, you know, who knows how much longer he can play, like his body's been.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on the Joel Embiid group chat rumors
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid is a good dude, but he is known for having burners, so who knows.
quotes.quote: Joel Embiid is a good dude, but he is known for having burners, so who knows. People, everything with AI, with this, with that, you don't know what's real. So, I'm not about to say it's for sure him without knowing for sure. But like if I had a teammate and like a group chat came out where my teammate was talking crazy about all of us, that would be wild though.
